lines.t: I'm calling out the doctrine that's twisted and grim
That endless torture and hellfire hooked on a whim
Who sold his horror as justice, made fear the key
Trading mercy for torment, that ain't the decree
Love is the law, but they add gasoline
Preach that flames never quit, but the end's not seen
Judgment is real, but the sentence unfolds
Life or death, he keeps what he holds
Tear it down, tear false doctrine apart
Expose every lie, let the real truth start
No more traditions that poison the well
No more fear mongers peddling hell
They sell you a feast, but it's pagan in root
Holy days swapped out for fables that loot
Debt calls with customs stolen from gods
Dress up the sermons and coaches facade
Light up a tree, name it holy they claim
But the roots run deep in a Babylon name
You say you adore him but you honor the old
Lost in a winter just chasing fool's gold
Turn back to the Sabbath, forget Sunday's snare
Friday at dusk, real rest declared
Holy convocations appointed and pure
Not swapped for rituals, men just prefer
Don't desecrate what was hallowed and set Calendar rewritten, but the law is not met
Tear it down, tear false doctrine apart Expose every lie, let the real truth start
Give up the holidays, let the old ways fall Return to what's written, heed the call
Sleepers in death, no fire keeps them burning The dead know nothing, just silence and yearning
Await the call when the voice commands
Tombs crack open at the king's demand
No half-truth after life, no haunted soul
The promise is resurrection
To be made whole, false shepherds
Dressed up with golden esteem
They fill up the pews, sell fantasies dreamed
Tickle in the ears, entertaining the crowd
But the Lord's got controversy, he's not proud
Why you break every command and then claim his name?
Why you celebrate lies and multiply shame?
Missing the narrow, stuck in the broad
Trading this Torah for applause and facade
Tear it down, every counterfeit fight
Let the pure doctrine rise, let the darkness take flight
It's greater than creed or a stained glass throne
It's repentance, perfection and faith alone
No more masquerades, no more man-made crowns
Truth is the banner, now tear it down
Tear it down
Tear it down
Tear it down
Tear it down
